scope: Sampled collision-envelope clearances and unsupported-subtree static gravity moments.

unverified: Continuous paths and poses outside the declared Cartesian samples and selected geometry pairs.
Physical geometry and tolerances; mesh distances use convex hulls, not concave CAD surfaces.
A support-plane bound below the required clearance is incomplete unless another sample proves failure.
Ground reactions, balance, leg loads and locomotion; samples need not be stable or reachable.
Acceleration, impact, friction, springs, actuator thermal limits and fatigue.
Controller reachability: configured actuator force caps do not prove available drive torque.
Bearing radial/axial force ratings, load paths, mounting stiffness and material stresses.
Hardware evidence for all estimated masses, capacities and geometry.

coverage.distance_fallback: Positive convex support-plane gaps certify lower bounds when native distances conflict.
coverage.sampling: Deterministic Cartesian groups; unsampled joints reset to home for each group.

assumptions: Unweighed component masses, box-surrogate inertias and provisional motor envelopes. The retained 600 g integration reserve is not a measured component.
Actuator caps and joint ranges are retained from the baseline. The 2 mm clearance and 80% torque-use criteria are unchanged planning thresholds, not hardware qualification.

The 729-pose expression grid combines lower, midpoint and upper limits. Twelve independent five-angle leg sweeps hold other axes at home; the home pose is also checked. Combined leg and expression movements and intermediate angles remain unverified.

Selected pairs cover all 66 leg motor-case pairs, the declared upper occupied volumes against each other, and every upper volume against each motor case. Direct distances include same-body and parent-child pairs despite normal contact filtering.

Shell volumes describe approximate occupied panels and mounting openings. Decorative surfaces, electronic packing, wiring, foot and leg-link pairs, mounting tolerances and assembly access remain outside this clearance screen.
Gravity moments cover unsupported expression subtrees. Bearing capacities are unknown. Ground reactions, leg loads, acceleration and thermal behavior require separate analyses.
